summary: Preserve the latest exact RFI or Submittal scope across continuation pages of a PDF while retaining bounded parallel page parsing.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI and Submittal accuracy, adaptability and efficiency
An offline two-page reproduction left a page-2 RFI response requirement without workflow scope
TXT and DOCX already retain active exact workflow scope until another exact heading replaces it
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy, adaptability and efficiency improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only exact digit-bearing RFI/Submittal headings start or replace carried scope; ambiguous prose does not.
Scope follows sequential pages until another exact workflow heading or the document ends, matching existing sequential text behavior.
The change does not infer authority, approval precedence or semantic membership across separate files.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer document, OCR, external provider or paid model is used.
